lines.arrive: A sunny afternoon. Everything feels real.
lines.solid: The grass, the trees, the warmth. All of it feels solid.
lines.edge: The world ends here. Just past the edge, it flickers.
lines.ask: If none of this were real, how would you ever know?
lines.lab_1: A brain, in a jar of fluid. Wires. A humming machine. And above it, the world you just left.
lines.lab_2: So this is what's real. Isn't it?
lines.layer_2: Another brain. Another machine. Another world above it.
lines.sit: You sit down. The sun is warm.
lines.stay_end: Real or not, it's the only sun you have.
lines.end: However far you climb out, you're still looking through the same eyes.
